conflicts.sub: Active facts that disagree. Keep one, give a reason, and the next answer follows.

conflicts.keepSub_other: From the {doc}, {date}. The other {count} facts will be retired. Nothing is deleted.

conflicts.done: Conflict resolved. The next answer follows your decision.
conflicts.noEvent: Could not find the change to undo. Use the audit log.
conflicts.emptyOpenS: Every topic has one binding fact. New conflicts appear here when two active facts disagree.
conflicts.emptyResS: Resolved conflicts keep the winning fact, the reason and who decided.

audit.sub: Every change to memory, who made it and why. Undo puts it back.

maint.sub: Facts proposed for retirement. Approving retires the fact with a reason; nothing is deleted.
maint.dismissed: Proposal dismissed. The fact stays as it is.
maint.emptySub_pending: Superseded facts that are still retrievable, stale facts and low-confidence facts are proposed here.
maint.emptySub_approved: Items move here after a decision. Each one can be undone.
maint.emptySub_dismissed: Items move here after a decision. Each one can be undone.

oq.sub: Things the sources never settled. Pick a value or write the answer, with a note.

oq.notePh: The answer, as a sentence people can reuse, or how you know.
oq.done: Question closed. It is now part of memory.
oq.emptyOpenS: Questions appear when sources leave something unanswered or give competing values.
oq.emptyClosedS: Closed questions keep the answer and who gave it.

s1.label: Last Monday

s2.label: What the AI believes

s3.label: Retire the old figure

s4.label: Today

s5.label: Contested

s6.caption: An email from the client is routed to the project by a mail rule. Its figure supersedes the current one.
